behaviour.title: Replace the Twilio sender number
behaviour.detail: The from number is +15550100000, which is in the reserved fictional 555-01xx range and is not a number anyone can send from. Twilio rejects it. Put a number on your own account here, or a Messaging Service SID.

behaviour.title: Set a real fallback for the placeholder expressions
behaviour.detail: "ONCALL_NUMBER" appears as the fallback branch of an expression. When the upstream field is missing the expression does not fail - it resolves to that literal string and the call is made with it, which reads downstream as a malformed value rather than as missing data.

behaviour.detail: "Upsert into Notion" is named as an update or upsert but runs operation create, which always writes a new record. bindings.title: Import "lib: Post-Process Orders" and select it on Offload to Post-Process Sub-workflow
bindings.detail: This template calls a separate workflow named lib: Post-Process Orders, and it is included in your download as lib/lib-post-process-orders.json. Import that file into n8n first (Workflows -> Import from File), then open Offload to Post-Process Sub-workflow and pick it in the workflowId selector. The selector is empty until you do: a workflow id only exists inside your own instance, so it cannot be set for you.

bindings.title: Select the Google Sheets documentId
bindings.detail: The dropdown shows "Order Tracker", which is a placeholder label with no value behind it - the node looks configured and is not. Open each of: Append Audit Row (Google Sheets), Archive Row Snapshot, Read Pending Queue (Google Sheets) and pick the real documentId from the list.

bindings.title: Select the Notion databaseId
bindings.detail: The dropdown shows "Order Database", which is a placeholder label with no value behind it - the node looks configured and is not. Open each of: Load Previous Snapshot, Mark Completed in Notion, Park in Dead-Letter Queue and pick the real databaseId from the list.

behaviour.title: Set a real fallback for the placeholder expressions
behaviour.detail: "OPS_CHAT_ID" appears as the fallback branch of an expression. When the upstream field is missing the expression does not fail - it resolves to that literal string and the call is made with it, which reads downstream as a malformed value rather than as missing data.

behaviour.title: Point the HTTP calls at your own endpoint
behaviour.detail: The URLs "api.example.com", "enrichment.example.com" are illustrative - example.com is reserved for documentation and resolves to nothing useful. Replace them with the service you are actually calling, and set that service's authentication on the node.

behaviour.title: Clear the pinned sample data before going live
behaviour.detail: "Hourly Schedule" carries pinned sample data, which is what lets the workflow run end to end before you have wired anything up. While it is pinned, a manual execution reads the sample and never calls the real service - so the run succeeds and proves nothing about your setup. Unpin it once the credentials and bindings are in place.
